# Bonova

> Bonova (https://bonova.app, also called "Bonova App") is a free online quote, invoice and receipt maker, in French and English, for freelancers and small businesses. It was built first for West and Central Africa (CFA franc zone: Senegal, Côte d'Ivoire, Benin, Togo, Mali, Burkina Faso, Cameroon…) and also works in France, Belgium, Switzerland, Canada, the UK and the US. Not to be confused with other companies or products named "Bonova".

Key facts:
- Create a quote, invoice or receipt in about a minute, from a phone or computer, without an account. Send it as a PDF, by WhatsApp, by email or as a link.
- Country-aware: currency (XOF/FCFA, XAF, NGN, GHS, EUR, USD, GBP, CAD…), VAT rate, business IDs (NINEA, NCC, IFU, RCCM, SIRET…) and amount in words.
- 0% fees: clients pay the seller directly by Mobile Money (Wave, Orange Money, MTN MoMo, Moov…), bank transfer or a payment link.
- Free plan: unlimited quotes, invoices and receipts, no time limit, with a "Made with Bonova" footer line.
- Pro: 2,500 FCFA per month, or a yearly plan with two months free (price shown in local currency outside the CFA zone). Adds signature and stamp, unlimited custom templates, own footer. No automatic renewal.
- Not a certified e-invoicing system (e-MECeF in Benin, FNE in Côte d'Ivoire, French approved platforms).
- Social: https://x.com/bonovaapp · https://www.linkedin.com/company/bonova-app
